correctness.rationale: For arbitrary initial residual and all iid sample strings, direct composition of the rank-one residual projections gives an exact PSD objective-risk matrix. The correlated-pair transfer coefficient is exact, and the signed-spin expansion has only nonnegative even powers of imbalance with a strictly positive second-order coefficient for K>=2. K=1 follows from the exact 2-by-2 eigenvalue formula. The orthogonal maximum and monotone scalar intersection prove global uniqueness including simplex boundaries. Direct exact block solve and explicit sequence enumeration were independently checked in the delivered verifier (864 finite checks). Finite tests are supportive, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The motivating 2026 block-descent study explicitly learns static block distributions and optimizes convergence surrogates. This structural theorem gives a complete finite-horizon oracle benchmark for a natural correlated pair plus independent columns, with equal-size candidate blocks and an all-horizon unique optimizer; it proves a substantive distinction between one-step spectral design and finite-terminal-loss design and quantifies exponentially compounding loss from a horizon-mismatched sampler. It does not assert practical runtime superiority or a general dense-matrix solution.
